findings.excerpt_or_summary: Two commits added 16 regional observation JSON files, 8 per commit; each file contains six records. All 96 records inspected are status NOT_CONFIGURED, model is empty/unspecified, synthetic=false, and the same six probe input hashes recur across regions.
contradictions: Observation file naming suggests regional observations, but no endpoint/model was configured; do not treat records as model responses or semantic benchmarks.
findings.next_action: Keep these records out of semantic benchmarks; decide whether to move no-endpoint status into a collection-status stream and prevent empty observations.

findings.excerpt_or_summary: publish-observations stages regional JSON and executes git commit followed by git push to main. Latest run 41760366466 shows DRIFT_ENDPOINT, DRIFT_TOKEN and DRIFT_MODEL empty; each job uploaded the entire historical directory (1921 files), and publish-observations pushed eight new files directly to main.
contradictions: Current workflow behavior conflicts with the user's no-direct-main-writes rule.
findings.next_action: Open a separate reviewed PR to replace direct push with PR creation, upload only the new file, and ensure NOT_CONFIGURED records are not treated as observations.
